intro: Bulgaria has one of the EU's fastest-growing but still poorest economies, strong in IT, energy and farming.

chapters.title: What Bulgaria makes
text: Bulgaria produces much of the world's rose oil, grows sunflowers, wheat and tobacco, and runs a nuclear power station at Kozloduy. Sofia has a growing IT industry.

chapters.title: Tourism
text: Black Sea resorts and ski areas such as Bansko attract visitors. Wages are among the lowest in the EU, and many Bulgarians work abroad.
